liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Touch of Grey** (1 review): Jerry has trouble remembering the lyrics in the opener, and it shows [16]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): After a two-minute tuning session, Bob is a half step out of tune as the song starts [18]
- **Beat it on Down the Line** (1 review): The reviewer thinks Bobby sang this over the top, out of frustration at forgetting lyrics [19]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Estimated Prophet and the post-Space material are the high points of an otherwise middling show [25]
- The set continues past it, unusual for later Brent-era shows, and it follows another Bobby song [24]
- The band was trying Beat It followed by Promised Land and then a Jerry song; Bob wouldn't end the set there [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-01-30.141947.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 26 songs; 158 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: The Oade FOB recording is wonderful and sounds excellent [25]
- **gd87-01-30.sbd.hinko.19299.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 156 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Vocals sit fairly high in an otherwise decent soundboard mix; The soundboard recording sounds nice, though the Iko Iko is badly messed up [16][18]
- **gd1987-01-30.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83285.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 156 min; rated 2/5 by 6 [3]. Said about its sound: The soundboard recordings of this three-night run sound beautiful; The reviewer finds the soundboard sounds nice and the show very danceable; Reviewer prefers the FOB sources to Healy's mixes, since Healy was still experimenting with his tape mixes then [19][20][24]
- **gd1987-01-30.177927.neumann.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 157 min [5]
- **gd1987-01-30.148707.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 154 min [7]

## Around the show

- These shows came right after the death of Bob's dog Otis, which may explain Bobby's extra intensity [17]
- Bobby is still recovering from an off night the evening before, making this an average show [16]
- Bobby struggled through the first two nights of the run, and this night is no different [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-01-30.141947.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC4/MK41 mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]
- **gd87-01-30.sbd.hinko.19299.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > MC > C > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN [2]
- **gd1987-01-30.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83285.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Maxell MX90/Sony D5) [3]. Also: Soundboard from tapes supplied by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; an unknown audience source from LMA fills in at Beat It On Down The Line [3]
- **gd1987-01-30.177927.neumann.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bill Bradt; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bill Bradt's Master Audience Cassettes: Neumann mics (likely KM84i's) > Sony D5M (Denon HD-M 90) [5]
- **gd1987-01-30.148707.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master Audience Cassettes; Neumann KM84i mics > Sony D5M [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead San Francisco Civic Auditorium 1-30-1987](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/san-francisco-civic-auditorium-1-30-1987) [28]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-01-30 San Francisco Civic Auditorium, San Francisco, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-01-30-san-francisco-civic-auditorium-san-francisco-ca-usa/) [29]
